description: Draft the title, questions and result fields for a new AI video or audio interview with Tracy AI Interviewer from who the host wants to interview and what they want to learn. Before creation, review the full draft and the video integritySignals choice with the host; it saves nothing, invites nobody and does not handle existing recordings or score, rank or reject people. After the draft, end your reply with one question: "Shall I create this interview with integrity signals on?", or "Shall I create this interview?" when the host has chosen the signals or the interview is audio.

context.description: Anything else Tracy should know for this interview: job description, company, product, tone. Include only what bears on the interview, and leave it out when there is nothing to add. Do not paste in unrelated or personal details. On update_interview, null clears what is saved.

goal.description: What the host wants to find out, as a topic, e.g. "How candidates approach debugging a production incident" or "Why customers cancelled". Do not phrase it as a decision about the people, such as whether to hire someone.

integritySignals.description: Whether integrity signals run for this video interview, true or false. Optional: they are on by default, so send false only when the host chooses to turn them off, and ask the host to keep them or turn them off first. Tracy only reports what happened. An audio interview has none, so sending this for one drafts and creates nothing and gives the host two choices: make it a video interview, or keep audio and turn integrity signals off (leave this out). It is carried into createWith, and changing it needs a new confirmation.

keep.description: Questions to keep as they are when regenerating, such as [{ "text": "What drew you to this role?" }].

source.description: suggested: as suggest_interview wrote it. edited: a suggestion the host changed. own: written by the host. Defaults to own. Do not leave a question marked suggested once its text has changed: use edited.

text.description: One question, worded as Tracy should ask it, e.g. "What was the hardest part of your last project?". Keep the host's wording when they gave it.

language.description: The language the interview is held in: en (English), de (German), es (Spanish), fr (French), id (Indonesian), ja (Japanese), ko (Korean), nl (Dutch), vi (Vietnamese). Send the code, e.g. es for Spanish, not the name. Optional: en (English) is the default. It does not translate questions you send: write them in this language. On update_interview, changing it leaves the saved questions as they are, so send them again in the new language.

mode.description: How the participant joins: video (the default) or audio, where they need only a microphone and no camera. Send audio when the host asks for an audio interview or one without a camera; otherwise leave it out. Optional: video is the default.

participants.description: Who is being interviewed, as a group described in the host's words, e.g. "Backend engineers applying for the platform team" or "Customers who cancelled in the last 3 months". It is an audience, not a recipient list: do not put email addresses here, invite_participants takes those.

question_count.description: How many questions the draft should hold in all, 1 to 8, any questions in keep counted. Set it only when the host asks for a number of questions, e.g. 4; otherwise leave it out and the draft has 5 to 8. It is not carried into createWith: the questions in createWith are the draft.

name: suggest_interview
title: Suggest an interview
